_comment: Hardware we actually own. This is the durable asset — events come and go,
the inventory carries forward. An event's rig selects units from here and
assigns DMX addresses, positions and roles; it never redefines the hardware.
'qxf' names a file in shared/fixtures/ (the definition that survives a fresh
clone). 'modes' lists the modes actually used, not everything the fixture
supports. 'count' is units owned, which may exceed units used in any show.
Derived from the cosmos26 and despacio workspaces on 2026-08-06. Counts are
what those two shows patched — verify against the physical road cases before
relying on them for a new event.

fixtures.notes: 14-slot mechanical color wheel, no color mixing. Strobe re-opens at 250-255. Channel 10 is Reset — always pin to 0. Used by: despacio.

The only fixture used by BOTH events. Channel 0 is a mode selector, not a dimmer — the usable band is 240-255. Group=Effect, so it is LTP not HTP. Its .qxf lived only in the gitignored qlcplus/ vendor tree until 2026-08-06.
Dimmer, R, G, B, strobe. Used by: cosmos26.
Also supports 3/5/90/94-channel pixel modes. Used by: cosmos26 (though absent from its patch sheet).
Laser — check local rules before pointing it anywhere near people. Used by: cosmos26.
Appears in the cosmos26 patch sheet but was NOT patched in the workspace that actually ran. Confirm we still own it before planning around it.
QLC+ built-in generic profile, no .qxf needed. The cosmos26 sheet claims 4; the workspace patched 1. Verify the real count.
